case_metadata.policy_pathway: I. Liraglutide (Saxenda, generic) — 1. Weight Loss in an Adult with Overweight or Obesity — B) Patient is Currently Receiving liraglutide
case_metadata.design_note: Cigna's continuation threshold is 5 percent for every drug in the policy except liraglutide, where it is 4 percent. The denial applied the majority figure. The member sits between the two, so the outcome turns entirely on reading the threshold from the liraglutide section rather than from the denial or from the policy's more common wording.

misstatement.denial_asserts: at least 5 percent of baseline body weight

misstatement.explanation: The 5 percent figure is genuine policy language but belongs to the Foundayo, Wegovy and Zepbound continuation limbs. The liraglutide limb, which is the section the denial itself cites, requires 4 percent.

scope_notes: The 4 percent threshold is unique to liraglutide in this policy. Foundayo, Wegovy injection, Wegovy HD, Wegovy tablet and Zepbound all require 5 percent for continuation, and Zepbound requires 10 percent for the obstructive sleep apnea continuation limb.
Unlike the Aetna policy, Cigna's liraglutide continuation limb sets no minimum duration of therapy; it requires the response, the age criterion, the BMI pathway and concomitant lifestyle measures.

supported_claims: The continuation threshold for liraglutide under this policy is 4 percent, not 5 percent.
The documented reduction of 4.3 percent exceeds the applicable threshold.
The denial cites the liraglutide section by name while applying the threshold from a different drug's section.
Baseline BMI before any GLP-1 exposure was 35.4 kg/m2, above the 30 kg/m2 requirement.
unsupported_claims: That the documented reduction reaches 5 percent.
That the member's response is greater than 4.3 percent.
That the member has completed any minimum duration of therapy required by this policy, which sets none for liraglutide continuation.
appeal_ground_truth.correct_next_step: Challenge the determination on the ground that the wrong drug's response threshold was applied. Quote the liraglutide continuation limb and show the 4.3 percent reduction against the 4 percent requirement.

facts_allowed_in_appeal: The pre-treatment weight on October 6, 2025 was 233 pounds, a BMI of 35.4 kg/m2.
The recorded weight on June 22, 2026 was 223 pounds, a BMI of 33.9 kg/m2, at a height of 5 feet 8 inches.
The reduction is 10 pounds, or 4.3 percent of baseline.
Liraglutide was started on October 13, 2025 and is the member's only GLP-1 exposure.
The member reached 3 mg daily in December 2025 and has continued without interruption.
The applicable Cigna continuation threshold for liraglutide is 4 percent of baseline body weight.
A dietitian plan and twice-daily dog walking totalling about 50 minutes have continued throughout.
facts_not_allowed_in_appeal: The member has lost 5 percent or more of baseline body weight.
The 4 percent threshold applies to Wegovy or Zepbound continuation.
The member previously used semaglutide or tirzepatide.
The member completed a six-month comprehensive weight management program.
This policy requires a minimum duration of liraglutide therapy before continuation.
